segments.name: Fintech services
segments.description: Operates an SEC-registered crowdfunding funding portal, a broker-dealer, and consulting services enabling private companies to raise capital from investors.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in a single operating segment, which is the provision of fintech services.

revenueModel.text: Private companies pay listing fees, a percentage-based portal/success fee on capital raised, and ancillary service fees, with consulting clients paying cash fees and previously equity.
revenueModel.evidence: The Netcapital funding portal charges a $5,000 listing fee, a 4.9% portal fee for capital raised at closing, and beginning in fiscal year 2025, a 1% success fee paid for with equity of the funding portal customer.

changes.text: In November 2024, subsidiary Netcapital Securities received FINRA approval to operate as a broker-dealer, expanding the model to Regulation A offerings.
changes.evidence: In November 2024, wholly owned subsidiary, Netcapital Securities Inc. received approval from FINRA to become a FINRA-member broker dealer.

changes.text: The company did not seek consulting engagements in fiscal 2025 and does not plan to in fiscal 2026, ending its consulting business.
changes.evidence: Given our limited staff, we did not seek consulting engagements in fiscal 2025 and we do not plan to seek them in fiscal 2026.
